about.title: A gentlemen's retreat in the heart of Leuven
about.lead: Kameraad is more than a barber's chair. It's a place where time slows down and details matter.
about.body1: Kameraad Haarsnijder grew out of the idea that there was no such thing as a gentlemen's retreat. Today Kameraad is by far the last retreat for men of all ages. Sit down, stay a while: a fresh cup of coffee, today's paper, a quiet moment — with or without an appointment.
about.body2: At Parijsstraat 29 in Leuven we don't follow trends blindly. We choose them, with care. Our barbers are craftsmen with deep respect for the trade — each with his own eye, united by one standard: quality without compromise.

legal.title: Privacy policy
legal.intro: Kameraad Haarsnijder respects your privacy. This policy explains which personal data we collect when you book an appointment, why we process it, how long we keep it and which rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
legal.controllerBody: Kameraad Haarsnijder, Parijsstraat 29, 3000 Leuven, Belgium. For any questions about your data: info@kameraadhaarsnijder.be.
legal.dataIntro: When you book an appointment, we process:
dataItems: Appointment details (service, barber, date and time)
An optional note you add yourself
legal.purposeBody: We use your data solely to manage your appointment: confirming, reminding, rescheduling or cancelling it and the related emails. We only send marketing messages if you give explicit consent for them; you can withdraw that consent at any time via the unsubscribe link in every email.
legal.legalBasisBody: Processing for your appointment is based on the performance of our service at your request. Marketing communication is based on your consent.
legal.retentionBody: We keep your data as long as necessary to manage your appointments and meet our legal obligations. You can request deletion of your data at any time.
legal.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
rightsItems: Access to the data we hold about you
Deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)
Object to certain processing and withdraw your consent
legal.rightsBody: To exercise any of these rights, email us at info@kameraadhaarsnijder.be. We carry out your request for access, export or permanent deletion within a reasonable period.
legal.cookiesBody: We only use functional cookies needed to make the website work, such as remembering your language choice. We do not set tracking or advertising cookies.
legal.complaintBody: If you have a complaint about how we handle your data, you can contact the Data Protection Authority (www.gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit.be).
legal.provisional: PROVISIONAL — drafted by the development team, pending legal review.
